Member.description: A student or member of staff. A first name alone is not an identity.

Module.description: A taught module, named by its code.

Teaching.description:
Who teaches on a module: its convenor runs it, a tutor takes seminars, an examiner marks externally.
Tutoring a module is not convening it.

Advising.description: A pastoral or research link between two members: one is the other's personal tutor or supervisor.

Extension.description: A coursework extension. student is who gets the time, filed_by submitted the request, approved_by decides it.

Exam.description: A sitting of an examination paper; a postponed sitting has not been sat.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Module)-[:convenor]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.code = 'LING110' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Which modules are tutored by me?
questions.speaker: oksana
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:tutored]->(n1:Module) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.code AS code

questions.speaker: linh_p
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:personal_tutor]->(n1:Member) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name
MATCH (n0:Member)-[:supervisee]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Kwabena Asante' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many extra days were given on the problem set?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Extension) WHERE n0.assignment = 'problem set' RETURN n0.extra_days AS extra_days

questions.q: Is there a record of medical evidence for the problem set?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Extension) WHERE n0.assignment = 'problem set' RETURN coalesce(n0.medical_evidence, false) AS medical_evidence

questions.q: Was the MATH301 paper open book?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Exam) WHERE n0.paper = 'MATH301 paper' RETURN n0.open_book AS open_book
MATCH (n0:Exam)-[:invigilator]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.paper = 'oral exam' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Which extensions did Marisol Dizon file?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:filed_by]-(n1:Extension) WHERE n0.full_name = 'Marisol Dizon' RETURN n1.assignment AS assignment

questions.speaker: ainhoa
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)<-[:approved_by]-(n1:Extension) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.assignment AS assignment

questions.q: Who is the external examiner for MATH301?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Module)-[:examiner]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.code = 'MATH301' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: How many candidates registered for CHEM204 exams?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Module)<-[:module]-(n1:Exam) WHERE n0.code = 'CHEM204' RETURN n1.candidates AS candidates

questions.q: Which exams were in a great hall?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Exam) WHERE n0.venue CONTAINS 'hall' RETURN n0.paper AS paper

questions.q: What are the paper and sitting of every exam?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Exam) RETURN n0.paper AS paper, n0.sitting AS sitting
MATCH (n0:Module)-[:tutor]->(n1:Member) WHERE n0.code = 'MATH301' RETURN n1.full_name AS full_name

questions.q: Which modules are convened by me?
questions.speaker: kwabena
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Member)-[:convened]->(n1:Module) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.code AS code
